evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3491361 ($39.08, product W, in_person) scores 0.55 on the calibrated transaction model trained only on the bank's closed cases (out-of-time AUC 0.964 vs 0.866 for the bank's risk score). The bank's own risk score was 0.48.
Holder baseline from 13 earlier transactions: median $49.09, 95th percentile $111.53; the flagged amount is 0.8x the median.
Billing region 126 is among the 1 regions in this holder's history.

Cardholder C02354 reported the $39.08 charge as not theirs (case pack trigger, 2016-11-27 14:41:26). Measured on October: all 1,203 disputes the bank investigated were fraud, 15% of them scored under 0.05, so a low score does not clear a denial (1.00). If this is a planted dispute on a legitimate transaction, a score this size is 24.16x as likely on disputed fraud as on a legitimate transaction (0.96). Weighted equally: 0.98.
Account takeover: mixed-channel activity inconsistent with the cardholder, often with device and match-flag anomalies, pointing to stolen credentials.
Policy R2: Customer denies the transaction: BLOCK_CARD and CREATE_CASE; FILE_REPORT if exposure exceeds $1,000 or the case connects to a shared device profile or another card's fraud.
